caption: Convergence over 300 read sets (10 instance settings x 30 seeds): mean gap of the best solution so far to the best fitness any solver reached on the same read set. A curve is drawn where at least 90% of the read sets already have a solution. LKH-3's curve starts after its preprocessing, has no evaluation count and sits on the 0.001% floor (its gap is 0 by construction of the best-known value). Nearest neighbour is left out (gap about 5%).
